scope: First-pass independent review of the six prior QA artifacts; no portal-wide certification

findings.confidence: high for local integrity failure; unknown for deployed bytes and scientific values
findings.claim: The local cube/index.json fails the pinned release manifest's byte count and SHA-256.
alternatives: Local index changed after release promotion
Manifest points to different authoritative bytes
Deployed R2 object differs from the local checkout
findings.scientific_impact: Analyses pinned to this release cannot verify the local cube index; no wrong cube value has yet been demonstrated.
findings.action: Trace index and manifest generation, identify authoritative version, inspect deployed object, then issue a consistent versioned release if required.
findings.retest: Pinned local and deployed index bytes and SHA-256 both equal a newly documented manifest; then verify referenced cube payloads and representative decoded values.

findings.confidence: high for local Vite path; low for deployed site
findings.claim: The local AOI Everything export has release=null.
findings.reproduce: Run the local Vite server and python qa/functional/check_first_pass.py; inspect area-export.json top-level release (exit 1).
alternatives: PUBLISHED/release.json is absent by build design
dist/release.json exists because the launch build writes it
The deployed site may serve a valid release.json
findings.scientific_impact: A downloaded local export lacks a release identifier, weakening provenance; it does not show incorrect basin values.
findings.action: Supply release metadata to the development path or identify the atlas latest release in the export; report fetch failure instead of silently using null.
findings.retest: On local development and deployed targets, download Everything and assert a non-null release ID matching the served metadata and data release; preserve the exported basin IDs.

findings.confidence: high for retrospective held-out result; medium for generalization
findings.claim: Pskem same-month linear reconstruction has poorer held-out skill than training-month climatology.
findings.reproduce: python qa/model_validation/check_pskem.py; compare 2013-01 to 2017-12 model RMSE 35.834 and climatology RMSE 19.278 mm/month (59 valid months).
alternatives: Positive NSE uses the evaluation-period mean, a different baseline
This is a historical reconstruction with same-month climate, not a lead-time forecast
One invalid gauge month is excluded
findings.scientific_impact: A generic validated-model label can imply useful prediction although squared-error skill versus seasonal climatology is -2.455; the model artifact itself discloses that figure.
findings.action: Label the model as retrospective and present the baseline and 59-month scope alongside NSE; do not claim prospective forecast skill.
findings.retest: If prospective skill is claimed, define issue time and lead, use predictors available then, pre-register a held-out test, and compare with seasonal climatology with uncertainty.

findings.claim: Pskem interval calibration, source independence and geographic transfer are unverified.
findings.reproduce: Inspect results.json uncertainty.published_interval=null and check_pskem.py query.observations selection.
alternatives: No predictive interval is claimed by the artifact
The observation query may correctly resolve runs and revisions
findings.scientific_impact: No quantified predictive uncertainty or independent source-data rebuild supports wider model claims.
findings.action: Keep claims confined to the tested retrospective split; pin raw observations and revision policy before independent rebuild.
findings.retest: Rebuild input rows independently from pinned raw data; for any interval claim, check empirical coverage on held-out months and additional catchments.

findings.claim: The selected Siegfried et al. 2024 result has not been numerically replicated.
findings.reproduce: Inspect literature.json target_status=BLOCKED and the absence of retrieved input/code archives and a numerical reproduction script.
alternatives: The paper's baseline, 221 catchments, model and SSP5-8.5 projection differ from UZGEODATA's historical basin record
findings.scientific_impact: No inference of agreement or disagreement with the published -2.7% projection is justified.
findings.action: Acquire and verify the author code and data under documented licence, reproduce the original target, then separately compare only a matched design.
findings.retest: Hash-pin inputs, execute an identified code path to the target table value, document ensemble and median definitions, then independently recalculate it.

findings.claim: The passing topology and functional checks support only their sampled scopes.
findings.reproduce: python -c "from qa.data_audit.check_syr_darya_level07 import audit; print(audit()['status'])"; inspect functional results.json NOT TESTED scenarios.
alternatives: 0.6 km2 area difference is within 1.8 km2 source-field rounding bound
CSV, JSON and UI use the same project artifacts
The local GEE export is not an independently downloaded original shapefile
findings.scientific_impact: One 35-unit outlet's routing is supported; climate fields, other outlets and independent AOI geometry accuracy remain unverified.
findings.action: Keep the PASS statements scoped; pin source licence and original asset version; sample other topology and climate cases against separate sources.
findings.retest: Check exact membership for separately sourced outlets and variable/period-matched climate values against independent computations with declared tolerances.
